product_metadata.title: 11.5" Silicone Splatter Screen - Pan Cover with Folding Handle, High Heat Resistant Oil Splash Guard - Heat Insulation Cooling Mat, Strainer, Drain Board for Frying Pan（Black）
features: FOLDABLE HANDLE - Foldable handle for easy storage and keep you from burning your hand. Great product. Love the way that the handle folds in so that it doesn't take up as much room.
NON-STICK & EASY TO CLEAN - Just put it on the pan and no more trouble about sticking. Wash it in the water with dish soap or just throw it in the dishwasher.

MULTI USE KITCHEN TOOLS - Using as a grease and splatter screen, strainer, cooling mat, and also a drain board. As a pan cover/splatter screen avoid grease and sauce splatters. Use as a strainer to strain fluid off cooking pot or any food preparation container as desired. Put across standard size sinks and use as a drain board.

HEAT RESISTANT - Made by heat resistant silicone material( up to 445 degrees Fahrenheit). Safe for stove top use. The screen reduces dangerous hot grease or oil splatters with the patented silicone splatter proof screen. Do not put directly on flame or heating plate. Not for use in oven. Able to cool hot food on directly from oven or stove pan.

What makes our Silicone Splatter Screen different.

SILICONE MATERIAL. Our silicone material is a natural ingredient. It is food grade, with heat resistant, and nonstick which makes it easy to clean. Silicone rubber is generally non-reactive, stable, and resistant to extreme environments and temperatures from -148 to 572 °F while still maintaining its useful properties. Due to its natural properties and its ease of manufacturing and shaping, silicone material cost is higher. FOLDABLE HANDLE. Our foldable handle makes the splatter screen easy to storage. The rubber handle will allow added grip comfort and slip proof maneuvering. EASY CLEANING. No messy clean ups after frying or cooking. A quick wash with dish soap or wipe clean with damp cloth and air dry makes it suitable for daily use. Dishwasher safe. MULTI USE. It is a grease and splatter screen, strainer, cooling mat, as well as a drain board. As a pan cover/splatter screen, it prevents grease and sauce splatters.
